d:
The Queen of Fate is a story created by me and Marine (Akashimaru).

It is a series developed entirely using AI, so some elements may vary, but we always try to preserve the original narrative principles.
The script is written by me, while Akashimaru handles the revisions and image generations.

We know that for many people AI is not considered art, and this type of content may not appeal to everyone. Even so, we truly appreciate the support from those who choose to follow this story.

The series is planned to be released monthly, and maybe in the future it could be ported to Koikatsu, with greater fidelity to the original vision.

Dragun Akane and Marine thank you all.
